payload.name: Preserve Companion in Shared Activity Extraction
payload.description: When constructing memories from conversation and a user describes an activity or preference with 'we', 'us', or 'together', retrieve this Skill to ensure the companion and shared activity are captured.
content: During extraction, when a message uses first-person plural ('we', 'us', 'our') or 'together' to express an activity or preference, create a candidate that names the companion (if identifiable from conversation) and the shared activity.
Do not merge the shared activity only into a memory about the speaker alone; preserve it as a joint activity with the companion, using 'event' or 'relationship' memory kind as appropriate.
If the companion is not explicit, use the most recent person the speaker was discussing or leave the companion as the implied co-participant rather than dropping it.

solves: Construction extraction sometimes records only the activity when a speaker uses first-person plural, losing the companion and the relational fact. This Skill addresses that by requiring the companion and shared activity to be extracted together, enabling future questions about joint activities. It applies to any conversation where activities or preferences are expressed with 'we' or 'together'.
